definitions.explanation: A chemical product for cleaning — removing dirt, grease, or grime from surfaces, machinery, tableware, or the body. Made of {洗浄|せんじょう} (washing, cleansing) + {剤|ざい} (agent, preparation).

examples.japanese: トイレ{用|よう}の{洗浄剤|せんじょうざい}を{買|か}った。
この{洗浄剤|せんじょうざい}は{油汚|あぶらよご}れに{強|つよ}い。
examples.english: This cleaner is tough on grease stains.

examples.japanese: {医療|いりょう}{器具|きぐ}は{専用|せんよう}の{洗浄剤|せんじょうざい}で{消毒|しょうどく}する。
examples.english: Medical instruments are disinfected with a dedicated cleaning agent.

notes:
{洗浄|せんじょう} (washing, cleansing) + {剤|ざい} (agent, preparation). A general term for products used to clean surfaces and objects; more clinical or technical in tone than the everyday {洗剤|せんざい}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- トイレ{洗浄剤|せんじょうざい}: toilet cleaner
- {食器|しょっき}{用|よう}{洗浄剤|せんじょうざい}: dishwashing agent
- {洗浄剤|せんじょうざい}を{使|つか}う: to use a cleaning agent

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {洗剤|せんざい}: detergent — the everyday household word (laundry, dishes)
